report:
Reviewed the complete completed_body_boundary claim and all three ordinary implementation associations. Requirements are (1) the completed body is the incremental and scheduling boundary, (2) mutable inference steps are neither independently memoized nor published, (3) reuse follows the completed CheckedBody and semantic query dependencies, and (4) branch/poll ordering must not change that product. The architectural-foundations context expressly allows provisional coarse inputs to cause extra execution, while equal semantic results stop downstream propagation.

LocalFnSym::body is a Salsa tracked returns(ref) query keyed by the function symbol. It reads the checked signature, own CST and scope, allocates a fresh InferCtx, imports the signature and parameter environment, drives checking with block_on_body, finalizes, and only then returns finish's CheckedBody. InferCtx owns ordinary RefCell state for its egraph, runtime, stash, locals, expression slots, obligations and diagnostics; mutation and branch operations are ordinary methods, not tracked inference-step queries. Semantic GoalQuery proof/normalization calls consume canonical facts rather than publishing that mutable context. This accounts for the separation between reusable semantic queries and transient inference.

InferCtx::finish consumes the context, requires terminal obligations, a leaf ROOT version, a quiescent runtime and no unpublished wakes, and rejects unfilled expression slots. It extracts the completed diagnostics and delegates rooted reconstruction to finalize_typed_body. The latter copies the root and its reachable children in structural order into a fresh stash, follows ROOT type representatives and resolved expression slots, rejects unresolved variables/cycles, and copies locals in body order. Its maps are lookup caches rather than iteration-driven output, so transient allocation identities do not themselves determine the published tree. The added associations on LocalFnSym::body and finalize_typed_body preserve these essential sources in future reviews. This source inspection establishes the publication mechanism, not an exhaustive empirical proof of schedule independence.

The complete associated test set contains exactly sage_meta::todo::inference_completed_body_boundary. Its empty body has no assertions and is explicitly TODO, not ordinary passing evidence. Its comment accurately retains the missing matrix: unchanged and interface-equivalent requests must reuse without replaying inference, relevant interface edits must reexecute, and scheduler perturbation must yield identical completed bodies and diagnostics. Acceptance preserves that test deferral. Prerequisites are source-driven edit fixtures with query execution observations and controllable alternative schedules/branch order, with structural body and diagnostic comparisons; completion of those assertions is still outstanding. There is no N/A entry and no claim here that executing a placeholder proves behavior. No additional missing production obligation was identified in the reviewed publication boundary.

Commands actually executed: cargo meta review start/read, cargo fmt and cargo build (successful with existing warnings). No behavioral tests were executed for this review; only comment associations changed, and the sole associated test remains explicitly deferred. Fresh start captured the final associations and current implementation files before recording. Mandatory post-codegen and Sage sanity review of comment edits is coordinated centrally by the root agent.
